newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Cardoso to inaugurate Brasilia airport wing.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Cardoso to inaugurate Brasilia airport wing.

text.p: Brazil's President Fernando Henrique Cardoso was scheduled Monday to inaugurate the new central wing at International Airport Complex in the capital Brasilia, federal airport authority Infraero said.
Infraero said in a statement the wing is part of some $683 million in airport projects Infraero plans to complete this year at 27 airports nationwide.
The authority plans some $3.56 billion in investments between 1995 and 2000 to modernize and expand 62 airports throughout the country.

Infraero also said it has improved its financial situation, with sales rising to $750 million in 1995 and expected to reach $1 billion this year due mostly to better performance in its commercial-industrial area.

Commercial sales rose 30 percent in 1995 and are expected to rise another 20 percent this year due to the start-up of new Infraero businesses as well as greater returns on existing businesses, it said.
New businesses include hotels, a parking garage and private projects "capable of turning Infraero's network of airports into business centers, where airplanes also take off," it added.
